Hi Sam — appreciate the details. Quick answers inline and attached the PSO with additional technical notes.

- HSM-backed CMEK: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (CMEK) for Hosted and Dedicated deployments. AWS KMS can be configured to use CloudHSM key material; if you require FIPS 140-2/3 Level 3 HSM hardware, we recommend either:
  a) Using AWS KMS with CloudHSM-backed keys (we have customers who validate this for FIPS controls), or
  b) Deploying Redwood Private in your environment and integrating directly with an on-prem HSM (YubiHSM/Thales/other supported vendors) — our Private deployments can be configured to reference customer HSMs so key material never leaves your control.

- Key rotation and access: Customers may initiate CMK rotation via their KMS console or API; Redwood does not retain plaintext key material. For hosted/dedicated CMEK, Redwood holds encrypted key references and uses KMS API calls to perform decryption operations; we never persist plaintext keys. We can document the exact audit trail and API calls for your security team.

- In-transit encryption: All traffic between clients and Redwood is TLS 1.2+ (we recommend TLS 1.3 where supported). Traffic between Redwood components is mTLS and encrypted at the transport layer.

- Timeline for questionnaire: Thu 6/18 is reasonable — Camila will own the questionnaire completion.

Attaching: Redwood-KMS-PSO.pdf and a prefilled copy of the questionnaire (we will complete and return by Thu EOD). If you need earlier, let us know and we can prioritize.

Suggested next step: Technical call Thu 6/18 10:00 AM PT to walk through CloudHSM/CMEK flow and confirm Private deployment options. I'll send a calendar invite if that works.

Looping in a brief technical note for the record.

- Hosted/Dedicated with AWS KMS CMEK: Redwood makes KMS API calls to decrypt envelopes; we never store plaintext keys. Using AWS KMS with CloudHSM-backed CMKs generally meets FIPS requirements — customers often provide the KMS CMK ARN and manage rotation. We can support customer-initiated rotation; the decryption calls will fail if keys are disabled/revoked (so we recommend scheduled maintenance windows for rotation).

- Private/on-prem HSM: For customers requiring hardware key custody at the HSM level (no CloudHSM), Private deployments can be integrated with on-prem HSMs via PKCS#11. That setup requires an initial deployment project and an HSM connectivity runbook.

- Action for CAM/CAM+Sales: Recommend we load the prefilled questionnaire and include a short appendix in the PSO explaining the CMEK flow (KMS ARN examples, rotation workflow, logs/audit events).
